players.product: Electrostatic chucks and AD (aerosol deposition) ceramic chamber components for semiconductor etching equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: TOTO results briefing Q&A: FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New Business Domains (semiconductor ceramics) FY2027 plan, management (results briefing Q&A): confidence in achieving the sales plan is high because TOTO shares future plans with the semiconductor manufacturing equipment makers it supplies; the plan is built on customers' plans shared several years ahead; order status is not disclosed in detail. Electrostatic chucks are about 8 in 10 of the segment's sales, with the replacement share rising; AD components are the next largest product and are also planned to grow this year. Margin could rise from a higher electrostatic-chuck replacement ratio, but higher capex and R&D investment are expected to offset it.
quarterly_data.figure: Electrostatic chucks about 8 in 10 of segment sales

quarterly_data.quarter: TOTO results briefing Q&A: FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Middle East situation, management (results briefing Q&A): in Japan the main elements of the FY2027 impact are lower profit from the Q1 sales decline and higher external procurement costs - cost increases for electronic components and resin are large, and TOTO is prioritising delivering products to customers over cost; overseas it assumes higher energy costs. On the outlook: 'honestly, we don't know' - in every industry supply is assured only about 1 to 2 months ahead; industries, TOTO included, are working to stabilise things by around June, but cost increases are expected to continue and are built into the plan. The sales decline is expected only in Q1; the cost impact is negative for the full year.

quarterly_data.quarter: TOTO results briefing Q&A: FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Japan Housing Equipment, management (results briefing Q&A): Japan is not loss-making but its margin has been eroding gradually, so unlike mainland China TOTO will not do major surgery (rapid plant closures, headcount cuts) and will restore profitability gradually. In a stable market the base operating margin is about 4%, to be raised gradually toward its FY2030 margin target; the target includes up-front structural-reform investment costs, whose effect appears with a time lag. Pricing: overseas TOTO has historically passed inflation into prices every year and will do the same this year; in Japan price revision is seen as unavoidable given the external procurement cost increase, but is being considered carefully; last year's revision will be reflected in this year's results.

quarterly_data.quarter: TOTO results briefing Q&A: FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Americas, management (results briefing Q&A): at the sanitary ware plant in which it invested last fiscal year (as already disclosed), TOTO decided also to invest in production automation equipment given US labour costs and future productivity, and is considering sharing production with its existing Mexico plant. WASHLET units are currently all imported; investment in the US or a nearby area will be necessary (timing not stated).

quarterly_data.quarter: TOTO results briefing Q&A: FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Asia and mainland China, management (results briefing Q&A): Asia's planned profit decline reflects cost increases that arose after the annual price revisions made at the start of the overseas fiscal year, before the Middle East situation; energy costs are rising - natural gas is TOTO's largest energy input but not to a level that reduces operations, and in Vietnam business activity is not disrupted. Mainland China: market conditions have not changed much from last year; the profit improvement comes mainly from fixed-cost cuts such as plant closures, with production sized to the market; the second-half improvement and the operating margin target of 8 to 9% are driven by growth of the remodel business, and TOTO is steadily moving toward profitability.
quarterly_data.figure: Mainland China operating margin target 8 to 9%
